# Introduction - WxEngage standalone

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/webex-engage-standalone-introduction
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:29:25+00:00

Webex Engage's Live Agent Integration allows you to manage Conversations on Digital channels from within Webex Connect's Flow Builder.  
Webex Connect and Webex Engage - Live Agent (Standalone) integration allows customers to leverage Webex Connect's customer interaction automation capabilities for enabling customer self-service and support across digital messaging channels  
Webex Connect brings in the ability to receive customer inquiries from a range of digital messaging channels (listed below) and facilitate automated handling of these inquiries by leveraging AI-powered bots and third-party business systems (such as CRMs, etc.) with contextual and seamless escalation to a Live agent on Webex Engage's (Standalone) Agent Console when human intervention is needed.  
Webex Connect's Flow Builder is a key component of this solution, empowering clients to design seamless customer engagement and self-service experiences. It achieves this by leveraging various rich messaging capabilities and integrating with backend systems and applications to automate handling of customer requests.
